predictions.why: A restart clears the self-similar history, so the loop hazard drops back to the fresh-prompt level. Of d4fa's 378 right, 98 cap hits and 1 finished rule-A loop, the 99 failed problems get up to two fresh T 0.6 / top-p 1.0 draws. Each draw finishes about 45-50 % of the time, as fresh restarts did at top-p 0.95 (50 of 119 on the second attempt, 38 of 78 in K_fresh), and about 75 % of those finishes are right (60 recovered of 119 in the e870a1 restart row). That recovers about 51 problems, giving roughly 429.
